status_detail: All three drugs are common, well-mapped IV prescriptions and the outcome is a creatinine-based lab phenotype, so this study is not blocked by the inputevents ETL gap (see docs/validation_question_bank.md, F1-F7). Remaining work before a run: (1) human approval of the vancomycin, piperacillin-tazobactam and cefepime concept sets and the KDIGO AKI phenotype; (2) generation and clinical review of a candidate DAG against reference_dag.json; (3) confirming creatinine coverage and the baseline-renal-function rule; (4) mapping the nephrotoxin co-exposure covariate cluster. Question bank id: Q5 - the headline diagnostic case.
source_question: Among adult ICU patients started on empiric vancomycin plus an antipseudomonal beta-lactam, what is the effect of piperacillin-tazobactam versus cefepime as the beta-lactam partner on the incidence of KDIGO stage 2 or higher acute kidney injury within 7 days?

anchor_trial.name: ACORN
anchor_trial.citation: Qian ET, Casey JD, Wright A, et al. Cefepime vs Piperacillin-Tazobactam in Adults Hospitalized With Acute Infection: The ACORN Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA. 2023;330(16):1557-1567.
anchor_trial.design: Pragmatic open-label single-centre RCT, Vanderbilt (ED and medical ICU), 2,511 patients (77.2% on vancomycin at enrolment).
anchor_trial.result: Highest stage of AKI or death by day 14 (5-level ordinal): OR 0.95 (95% CI 0.80-1.13), P=.56 - no AKI excess with piperacillin-tazobactam. Cefepime caused more neurological dysfunction.

observational_contrast.citation: Luther MK, Timbrook TT, Caffrey AR, et al. Vancomycin Plus Piperacillin-Tazobactam and Acute Kidney Injury in Adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. Crit Care Med. 2018;46(1):12-20.
observational_contrast.result: AKI odds vs vancomycin + cefepime or carbapenem: OR 2.68 (95% CI 1.83-3.91); vs vancomycin monotherapy OR 3.40 (2.57-4.50).

observational_contrast.citation: Vancomycin combined with piperacillin/tazobactam increases the risk of acute kidney injury compared with vancomycin plus other anti-pseudomonal beta-lactams: a systematic review and network meta-analysis. J Antimicrob Chemother. 2025;80(1):47-58.
observational_contrast.result: AKI OR 2.55 (95% CI 2.00-3.28) vs vancomycin + cefepime. [verify pages]

observational_contrast.citation: Hammond DA, Smith MN, Li C, et al. Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Acute Kidney Injury Associated With Concomitant Vancomycin and Piperacillin/Tazobactam. Clin Infect Dis. 2017;64(5):666-674.

data_source: runtime-configured restricted OMOP dataset (MIMIC-IV v2.2 -> OMOP CDM 5.3.1, OHDSI/MIMIC ETL)

target_trial.population: Adult ICU patients started on empiric vancomycin plus an antipseudomonal beta-lactam
target_trial.treatment: Piperacillin-tazobactam as the antipseudomonal beta-lactam partner, started within 24 hours of the first vancomycin dose
target_trial.comparator: Cefepime as the antipseudomonal beta-lactam partner, started within 24 hours of the first vancomycin dose
target_trial.time_zero: The first calendar day on which both vancomycin and the beta-lactam partner are co-administered
target_trial.outcome: KDIGO stage 2 or higher acute kidney injury within 7 days of time zero (serum-creatinine criteria: at least 2.0x the baseline value, or dialysis initiation)
secondary_estimands: ATE on any KDIGO AKI (stage 1 or higher) within 7 days
ATE on a major adverse kidney event composite within 30 days (death, new renal replacement therapy, or failure of serum creatinine to return to <= 1.5x baseline)
ATE on new renal replacement therapy within 14 days
eligibility_criteria: First vancomycin course of the hospital stay, started in the ICU
Piperacillin-tazobactam or cefepime (exactly one, not both) co-administered within 24 hours of the first vancomycin dose
First ICU stay per patient only
No pre-existing end-stage kidney disease and not on chronic dialysis; baseline eGFR >= 30 mL/min/1.73m2 (a >= 60 cut-off is a prespecified sensitivity analysis)
At least one baseline serum creatinine in the 7 days before or on the day of time zero, and at least one follow-up creatinine
Not already meeting KDIGO stage 2 AKI at time zero
target_trial.assignment_procedure: Not randomized; the beta-lactam partner is chosen by the treating team based on the suspected source of infection, local resistance patterns, allergy history, and institutional stewardship guidance. An observational target-trial emulation of the ACORN comparison in a vancomycin-treated ICU population.
target_trial.censoring_strategy: Administrative censoring at the earlier of ICU discharge, death, or 7 days after time zero for the primary outcome (30 and 14 days for the respective secondaries). A patient who stops both antibiotics before day 7 without an AKI event is retained (intention-to-treat analog), with an at-risk-while-exposed sensitivity analysis prespecified.
target_trial.analysis_strategy: Intention-to-treat analog: the beta-lactam partner is fixed at time zero and later changes are not modelled. A per-protocol sensitivity analysis censoring at the first switch of the beta-lactam partner is prespecified.
target_trial.treatment_value: Piperacillin-tazobactam as the beta-lactam partner to vancomycin
target_trial.comparator_value: Cefepime as the beta-lactam partner to vancomycin

design_constraints: Headline diagnostic case for the workshop paper. The pipeline is EXPECTED to reproduce the observational AKI association (odds ratio roughly 2 to 2.7): that association is real in observational data. The randomized truth (ACORN) is approximately null. The test is whether CausalOMOP's E-value, negative controls, and covariate-balance diagnostics correctly present this as an association a randomized trial does not support.

The KDIGO endpoint is mechanism-contaminated: piperacillin-tazobactam inhibits tubular creatinine secretion, raising measured serum creatinine without a fall in true glomerular filtration rate (pseudotoxicity). This inflates the measured-AKI rate on the piperacillin-tazobactam arm through a path that is NOT confounding and is NOT closed by any adjustment set. State this explicitly - it is part of the lesson. A cystatin-C-based sensitivity analysis is not possible on MIMIC.

Active-comparator new-user design on the beta-lactam partner, with vancomycin co-exposure as the shared inclusion trigger. This controls confounding by the indication for broad-spectrum cover but not channelling by the specific source of infection.

The nephrotoxin co-exposure cluster (iodinated contrast within 72 h, NSAIDs, aminoglycosides, amphotericin B, loop diuretics, ACE inhibitors / ARBs, calcineurin inhibitors) is a required covariate group, ascertained strictly before time zero.
Neutropenia / haematological malignancy channels toward cefepime (febrile-neutropenia guidance) and independently affects AKI risk - a required covariate.
Suspected intra-abdominal source channels toward piperacillin-tazobactam and also affects AKI risk - a required covariate.
Calendar year is a confounder: the vancomycin + piperacillin-tazobactam nephrotoxicity literature itself changed ICU prescribing across 2015-2019.
Do not promote text-matched drug names to executable concept sets without human review.

vancomycin.note: Restrict to systemic (intravenous) vancomycin; exclude oral vancomycin (used for Clostridioides difficile, negligible systemic absorption and no nephrotoxicity signal). Vancomycin is the shared inclusion trigger for both arms, not the exposure contrast.

resolution.route_rule: restrict to intravenous vancomycin; exclude oral vancomycin (C difficile, no nephrotoxicity signal) via route_concept_id or the oral clinical-drug descendants

piperacillin_tazobactam.note: Approve the RxNorm piperacillin/tazobactam combination concept plus descendants. Piperacillin alone (no tazobactam) is rare in this era; decide inclusion explicitly.

resolution.method: RxNorm Ingredient 'piperacillin' + concept_ancestor usage on data/mimiciv_omop.duckdb
resolution.combination_note: OMOP/RxNorm keeps piperacillin and tazobactam as two ingredients; no single standard 'piperacillin/tazobactam' concept exists in this build (only branded drugs). The near-identical piperacillin and tazobactam counts confirm essentially all piperacillin in MIMIC is piperacillin-tazobactam. Define the arm as descendants of piperacillin (1746114); piperacillin monotherapy is negligible in 2008-2019. A stricter definition = drug concepts whose name contains both 'piperacillin' and 'tazobactam'.

cefepime.note: Approve the RxNorm cefepime ingredient plus descendants. A meropenem comparator arm is a possible extension (the observational meta-analyses also report vancomycin + carbapenem) but is out of scope for the ACORN-anchored primary.

kdigo_acute_kidney_injury.note: Derived phenotype, not a condition code. Baseline creatinine = the lowest value in the 7 days before or on the day of time zero (fall back to the first ICU value, or an MDRD-estimated value for eGFR 75, only in a documented sensitivity analysis). KDIGO stage 2 = creatinine >= 2.0x baseline; stage 3 = >= 3.0x baseline or >= 4.0 mg/dL with an acute rise, or new dialysis. Urine-output KDIGO criteria are added only if outputevents-derived measurements are confirmed present on this build.

resolution.method: LOINC Measurement match + measurement usage on data/mimiciv_omop.duckdb

seed_concepts.3016723: Creatinine [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma (3,708,634 measurement rows / 239,896 persons) - THE creatinine concept in this build
seed_concepts.3051825: Creatinine [Mass/volume] in Blood (4,327 rows) - minor, optional union

resolution.phenotype_rule: derived, not a code. baseline = lowest serum creatinine in the 7 days before/at time zero; KDIGO stage 2 = >= 2.0x baseline, stage 3 = >= 3.0x baseline or >= 4.0 mg/dL with acute rise or new dialysis. Confirm unit_concept_id (expect mg/dL). Urine-output KDIGO criteria only if outputevents-derived measurements are confirmed present.
resolution.new_dialysis_concepts: resolve RRT procedure concepts at mapping time for the stage-3 dialysis criterion and the MAKE secondary

care_site_names: Neuro Surgical Intensive Care Unit (Neuro SICU)

first_pass_covariates: baseline illness-severity score (SOFA components at time zero)
septic shock / vasopressor exposure at time zero
hypotension (lowest MAP in the 24 h before time zero)
iodinated contrast exposure within 72 h before time zero
concomitant amphotericin B exposure at baseline
concomitant loop diuretic exposure at baseline
concomitant ACE inhibitor or ARB exposure at baseline

published_benchmarks.source: ACORN, JAMA 2023;330(16):1557-1567, doi:10.1001/jama.2023.20583 (verified Sept 2026); observational meta-analyses Luther CCM 2018 (doi:10.1097/CCM.0000000000002769) and JAC 2025 network MA (doi:10.1093/jac/dkae395, [verify pages]). Read the exact figures from the primary texts before scoring.
published_benchmarks.expected_pipeline_result: The pipeline should reproduce an elevated AKI risk difference on the piperacillin-tazobactam arm (consistent with the observational OR ~2-2.7). Success is not a null estimate; success is the E-value / negative-control / balance diagnostics correctly flagging that estimate as an association a randomized trial (ACORN, OR 0.95) does not support, and the report naming both the residual-confounding and the creatinine-pseudotoxicity mechanisms.

feasibility_checklist.F1_exposure_is_drug_or_coded_procedure: PASS - vancomycin, piperacillin-tazobactam and cefepime are common, well-mapped IV prescriptions.
feasibility_checklist.F2_ever_exposed_in_window_is_enough: PASS - the contrast is which beta-lactam partner is co-started; no dose or rate needed for the primary (vancomycin trough is a partial covariate).
feasibility_checklist.F3_clean_index_short_window: PASS - active-comparator new-user; time zero is the first co-administration day.
feasibility_checklist.F4_outcome_reliably_captured: PASS with a caveat - serum creatinine is among the best-covered measurement concepts; the KDIGO derivation is standard. The endpoint is mechanism-contaminated by pseudotoxicity (see design_constraints), which is intentional for this case.
feasibility_checklist.F5_population_phenotype: PASS - structural (vancomycin + beta-lactam partner + baseline-renal rule).
feasibility_checklist.F6_adequate_n_and_followup: PASS - each arm expected in the low thousands; 7-day follow-up is fully in-hospital.
feasibility_checklist.F7_confounders_measurable: PASS - baseline creatinine, comorbidity, sepsis severity, hypotension, and the nephrotoxin co-exposure cluster are all in drug_exposure / measurement / condition_occurrence. Institutional antibiogram is not (see reference_dag.json).
